title: few-observation operator adaptation by Mirror code only
hypothesis: A four-coordinate phase View adapted from sparse operator observations attains held-out function quality comparable to an eight-coordinate CAVIA-style latent context with lower serialized task state and no shared-weight updates.
physical_object: fixed shared four-frequency operator basis and amplitudes
mirror_coordinate: four task-specific Fourier phase coordinates only
logical_multiplicity: task-specific operators inferred from few sensor/function observations

development.selection_metric: held-out input nRMSE, adaptation function evaluations, actual complete serialized bytes

fresh.reason: run all three only if development Mirror meets quality/storage gate

storage.authority: actual serialized full task-bank payload bytes

success_gate: On all three frozen calibration sizes, Mirror test nRMSE <=.05 and within 10% of CAVIA context error, task-state bytes <=.65x CAVIA, and adaptation evaluation count no more than 2x context solve. If promising, pass all three fresh seeds.
failure_gate: Quality, bytes or compute gate miss, or exact direct/native context representation alias, is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Analytic Fourier function family only; no neural network or physical PDE training.
No base model updates; task identities and observations are synthetic.
Fresh tasks are opened only after dev gate success.
